info.title: Sales Debt Management API
info.description: Standalone backend API for sales debt management. Successful responses are wrapped in a `{ success, statusCode, code, message, data, meta?, timestamp, path }` envelope; see docs/guides/api-response-format.md.

organizationId.description: Optional. Omit to select the earliest created active membership in an active organization. Supply a real organization ID only to choose a specific workspace you belong to; do not send the placeholder "string".

membershipId.description: Id of the membership of this user in the current organization.

status.description: Effective status: ACTIVE only when both the account and the membership are active.

membershipStatus.description: Status of the membership in this organization.

createdAt.description: When the user was added to this organization.

field.description: Name of the invalid input field.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Switch on this, display `message`.

errors.description: Field-level details, present for validation errors.

email.description: Login email. Stored lower-cased; must not belong to another account.

password.description: Initial password, hashed before storage. 8-72 characters with a letter and a digit.

role.description: Role in this organization. Only an OWNER can create another OWNER.

name.description: Full name. Editable only when the account belongs to this organization alone (or by the user themselves).

phone.description: Phone number, `null` clears it. Same restriction as `name`.

role.description: New role in this organization. Granting or removing OWNER requires an OWNER, and you cannot change your own role.

receivable.description: Remaining amount customers owe the organization (open and partial receivables).

payable.description: Remaining amount the organization owes the party (open and partial payables).

isActive.description: False after the party was deactivated.
False after the party was deactivated.

code.description: Optional business code, unique within the organization.

creditLimit.description: Maximum outstanding receivable allowed for this party, as a decimal string (>= 0).

assignedToId.description: Id of an active member of the organization responsible for this party.

isActive.description: False after the party was deactivated.

debts.description: Every debt of the party, nearest due date first.

creditLimit.description: Maximum outstanding receivable allowed for this party, as a decimal string (>= 0).

assignedToId.description: Id of an active member of the organization responsible for this party.

amount.description: Decimal string; for a debt's payments view this is the amount allocated to that debt.

payments.description: Payment amount is the allocation for this debt, rather than the full voucher amount.
